Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Nikto]]: the robot Gort in the trailer for ''The Day the Earth Stood Still'' (1951), the robot to whom "Klaatu barada nikto" is spoken.

License: Public domain (the trailer was published without a copyright notice), as marked on Wikimedia Commons.
